providers.name: Seven Seas Worldwide - Student Storage Durham
providers.studentDiscount: £30 off orders storing at least three Large boxes (auto-applied in quote)
providers.quote: 19p per day ... £1.30 per week ... based on the Standard box ... a minimum £84 charge applies
providers.notes: Only two box sizes: Standard 51x41x31 cm (~65 L) and Large 61x51x41 cm (~128 L). Large box price not published (quote tool only). Small mapped to Standard (no smaller box offered). Collection included; return free within 50 km of collection address, extra beyond (amount not stated). Min 4 weeks (shorter still charged), max 26 weeks then auto-renewing 4-week periods. £84 deposit (£70 + VAT). Up to 30 kg per box.

providers.name: LOVESPACE (storage by the box)
providers.studentDiscount: 40% off when storing 3 months or longer
providers.quote: Starting from £3.25 per box per month ... Get a 40% discount when you store for 3 months or longer
providers.notes: National 'from' price; Durham page shows no price (postcode quote only). Box sizes/dimensions not published; 25 kg weight limit per box. Collection from accommodation stated as free; a blog post mentions +£30 for doorstep collection above ground floor. Treat £3.25 as single per-box rate; exact price via quote.
